answer: Work waits on the atlas until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ivory of the next round. Reaching the jade of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
